pages.text: Casting draws a magic circle in the anime's style: a double outer ring, a band of ancient script, a fine tick ring and node circles, with a figure in the middle that shows the spell's family.
pages.title: Spell Circles

pages.text: Aimed spells draw it in front of you, area spells on the ground, Catastravia overhead and Judradjim high in the sky above its target. The golem's circle is a violet sunburst that opens under the target before the fist breaks through.
